description: This file defines an enum LogLocator with static methods and properties related to locating, managing, and retrieving log files within a specified directory. It includes functions for ensuring the log directory exists, fetching the most recent log file based on modification date, and providing paths for launchd configurations.

methods.name: ensureLogDirExists
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not already exist, using FileManager.

methods.name: modificationDate
methods.description: Retrieves the content modification date of a given URL, returning distantPast if unavailable.
